direction.positive_prompt: Elegant premium corporate event programme with strong visual hierarchy, black and gold color scheme, sophisticated typography, ample white space, subtle textures, and a luxurious feel.
direction.negative_prompt: Cluttered design, busy patterns, low-quality images, poor typography, lack of hierarchy, non-luxurious elements.
direction.short_design_rationale: A clean, sophisticated layout that emphasizes the event's prestige and elegance, using a black and gold color scheme with clear typographic hierarchy to ensure readability and visual impact.

direction.positive_prompt: Create one visual creative direction for an A4 portrait event programme. Elegant premium corporate event programme with strong visual hierarchy. Use the supplied event brief as the source of truth. Design only the visual background and composition concept. Do not render the actual event programme text into the background. Do not invent logos. Do not invent portraits. Return all layout zones as normalized coordinates between 0 and 1. x and y represent the top-left position of a zone. width and height represent the size of the zone. No zone may extend beyond the page boundary. The title zone and programme zone must not overlap. Only include a headshot zone when a headshot is supplied. Only include a logo zone when a logo is supplied. If no headshot is supplied, headshot_zone must be null. If no logo is supplied, logo_zone must be null. Keep sufficient visual space around all reserved content zones.
direction.negative_prompt: Cartoons, low resolution, amateurish, messy, cluttered, bright primary colours, childish, simplistic, minimal text
direction.short_design_rationale: A sophisticated and elegant design using the primary black and gold colour palette. The background will feature a subtle, textured gold gradient to create a premium feel. A large, central area will be dedicated to the ‘Annual Excellence Awards’ title, using a bold, refined typeface in gold. The programme content will be arranged in a clear and hierarchical manner, with ample whitespace to ensure readability and a sense of luxury.

direction.positive_prompt: Elegant, premium corporate event programme with strong visual hierarchy. Black and gold color scheme, celebrating excellence theme. Abstract geometric patterns with metallic gold accents on a black background. Clean typography with ample white space for readability. Subtle gradients and textures to add depth without distracting from content.
direction.negative_prompt: Overly busy designs, clashing colors, poor contrast, excessive use of images or graphics that distract from the text. Avoid childish or informal elements.
direction.short_design_rationale: The design emphasizes elegance and premium quality, aligning with the 'Celebrating Excellence' theme. The black and gold color scheme conveys sophistication and prestige. Abstract geometric patterns with metallic gold accents create a luxurious feel, while clean typography ensures readability. The layout prioritizes strong visual hierarchy, ensuring the content is easily navigable.
